research_question: What type of reason does the respondent provide?
study_context: Demonstration project only; replace these categories with a study-specific deductive framework.
general_instructions: Code only what is supported by the supplied text and context. Do not infer motives, identities, or meanings that are not reasonably supported.

codes.name: Evidence-based reason
codes.definition: The response explicitly refers to evidence, information, data, or documented facts.
codes.include_when: A reason is justified by information or evidence.
codes.exclude_when: The response relies only on personal experience.

codes.name: Personal experience
codes.definition: The response explicitly bases the reason on personal experience or direct observation.
codes.include_when: The respondent says they experienced, saw, or encountered something themselves.
codes.exclude_when: The response cites only external evidence or another person.

codes.name: Value-based reason
codes.definition: The response explicitly appeals to a value, principle, or normative standard.
codes.include_when: The reason depends on what the respondent considers right, fair, important, or acceptable.
codes.exclude_when: The statement is only descriptive and contains no value-based justification.

codes.name: No applicable deductive code
codes.definition: The response is substantive but none of the defined deductive categories applies.
